narrative.overview: A dark dimensional home stage leads into calm paper reading surfaces. Real object imagery remains central, and the staff console remains structured and quiet.

rules.name: Object first
rules.body: Place real object imagery and its guide before decorative branding.

rules.name: Depth at entry
rules.body: Keep the 3D collage treatment on the home stage; reading and staff surfaces stay flat.

dos: Do show real object photographs with captions.
Do distinguish summary, narration and audio.
Do make the page usable with reduced motion.
donts: Don't replace object imagery with abstract silhouettes.
Don't use color alone to indicate status.
Don't present demonstration images as a deploying museum's own collection.
